text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear paragraphing with topic sentences and a wrap-up conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"The essay presents its ideas in a more recognizable structure with an introduction, body paragraphs, and conclusion."},{"evidence":"\"Firstly,\" \"Furthermore,\" \"Lastly,\" \"In conclusion\"","quality":"transitions","description":"The essay uses more explicit linking words to connect reasons and guide the reader through the argument."},{"evidence":"\"research purposes,\" \"online shopping,\" \"communication,\" \"emergency purposes\"","quality":"idea development","description":"The essay develops several distinct supporting points instead of relying mainly on personal anecdotes."},{"evidence":"\"people who are disabled or unable to travel\" and \"students who are too busy\"","quality":"supporting explanation","description":"The essay more often explains how and why examples support the main claim."},{"evidence":"\"technology has had a positive effect on people's lives\"","quality":"sentence control","description":"The essay shows somewhat better control of sentence structure and overall readability, even though it still has errors."}]}
